description: Import a photo into Picorn storage, then use the returned imageUrl in one or more native image layers. Three sources: mediaId (a photo the user already uploaded to Picorn, from picorn_media_list; needs the access token), imageUrl (Dropbox or Google Drive share links work as-is when shared with "anyone with the link", as do Picorn, Google Cloud Storage, fal and Wikimedia URLs; up to 50 MB), or imageBase64 (up to 15 MB). Camera originals are rotated by EXIF and downscaled to 4096 px on the long side; opaque photos are stored as JPEG, transparent images as PNG. Prefer mediaId or a share link over base64 for full-size photos. With an access token the asset lands in a workspace owned by the user.

imageBase64.description: Image bytes as base64, with or without a data:image/... prefix.

imageUrl.description: An image URL or a Dropbox / Google Drive share link.

mediaId.description: A mediaId from picorn_media_list (the user's own Picorn uploads).

name.description: Asset name shown in the marketing project.

preview.description: Return an inline preview. Default true.

name: picorn_editor_import_image
title: Picorn Editor: import image asset
